title: Foggy night encounter with a scout craft piloted by a young lady

tellings.quote: on one cold and snowy night in the fall back in the 60s when I damn near died in the fog and the scout craft with the l young lady in it and some of her friends accompanied by the deep spacecraft and the teenage craft.

plain: Charles Hall, a former Air Force man who says he spent three years among tall white beings near Area 51, the secret Nevada test base, says that on a cold, snowy night in the 1960s he nearly died in thick fog in Indian Springs Valley, Nevada. He says a small scout craft flown by a young female being and some of her friends came to him, along with a larger deep-space craft and a craft flown by teenagers. He ties the story to a book, The Valley of the Grays, and tells it as part of his account of living alongside these beings.
